(The Crypt Keeper cackles as the camera zooms in on his ghoulish face in the dimly lit crypt.)

Crypt Keeper: "Greetings, kiddies! Welcome to a very special episode of Tales From The Crypt, where we'll take you on a journey through the stars and into the heart of darkness. Tonight, we present 'This Is Planet Earth,' a tale of cosmic horror and environmental disaster, told through the eyes of our extraterrestrial visitors. (The screen fades to a spaceship hovering above a polluted Earth.)

Alien Commander: "This is Planet Earth. Prepare for landing and exploration."

(Clip from "The Thing From The Grave" - A man is buried alive, struggling to breathe as dirt covers his face.)

Alien Scientist: "The sky is dirty, we cannot see it. The air is dirty, we cannot breathe it."

Alien Scientist: "The water's dirty, we cannot drink it. The food is dirty, we cannot eat it."

Alien Commander: "The land is dirty, we cannot use it."

Alien Scientist: "Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait. Prepare for takeoff, it wasn't worth it."

(The spaceship departs as news reports of UFO sightings play in the background.)

News Anchor: "A spokesman for the Bureau of UFOs discounted the reported sightings. However, reports of the sightings are coming in from every segment of the community. (The Crypt Keeper cackles as the camera returns to his crypt.)

Crypt Keeper: "Ah, the foolish humans, destroying their own planet, one toxic waste dump at a time. But fear not, my dear frights, for there are plenty more tales of terror and suspense to be told. Until next time, keep your eyes to the skies and your hearts filled with fright! Ha ha ha ha ha!"

(The screen fades to black as the Tales From The Crypt theme music plays.)
